title: FORGE: Fault-Oriented Rework Code Generation for Executable Interlocking Assembly
abstract: arXiv:2611.02536v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models have demonstrated strong capabilities in structured reasoning and code generation, yet identifying an assembly fault does not guarantee the ability to generate executable rework programs. In interlocking assemblies, a locally plausible repair program may violate blocking dependencies, omit required recovery operations, or terminate in an incorrect configuration. We identify this challenge as fault-conditioned executable rework generation, where models must jointly reason about structural failures and generate programs that restore constrained assembly states. To benchmark this capability, we introduce FORGE-Bench, containing 4,000 tasks across 26 interlocking assemblies with five assemblies held out for evaluating generalization to unseen structures. translated_title: FORGE：面向故障的联锁装配可执行返工程序代码生成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在结构化推理和代码生成方面已展现出强大的能力，然而识别出装配故障并不保证模型能够生成可执行的返工程序。在联锁装配中，一个局部看似合理的修复程序可能违反阻塞依赖关系、遗漏必要的恢复操作，或以错误的配置终止。我们将这一挑战定义为故障条件下的可执行返工生成，即模型必须同时对结构故障进行推理，并生成能够恢复受约束装配状态的程序。为了对该能力进行基准测试，我们提出了FORGE-Bench，其中包含跨26个联锁装配体的4,000个任务，并预留了五个装配体用于评估模型对未见结构的泛化能力。我们进一步提出了FORGE（面向故障的联锁装配可执行返工程序代码生成），这是一个结构化的从状态到程序的框架，将返工过程分解为……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了FORGE-Bench基准和FORGE框架，用于评估并解决大语言模型在联锁装配故障条件下生成可执行返工程序的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FORGE-Bench and the FORGE framework to benchmark and address the challenge of fault-conditioned executable rework code generation for interlocking assemblies with large language models.
